headline: Road Hornets Get the Nod
caption:
One bar does almost all the work in tonight's Hornets-Nets pick.

The biggest factor: recent point differential, which moves our model 7.0 points toward Charlotte. Team efficiency pulls 0.3 back toward Brooklyn, and tonight's players push 0.3 toward Charlotte. All of that outweighs the usual home edge (an average game: home team by 2.3).

The pick: Hornets at 66%. Brooklyn still wins this one about a third of the time.

Should recent form carry that much weight, or do the Nets hold serve at home?
